page.layout: One page: a table of numbers in ruled columns, with no headings. Running head at the top, page number at the top right, gathering signature at the foot right.
page.notes: The first figure of the last two values in the left column is cut off at the edge of the table and is unreadable; the value is taken from the right-hand column (400 and 500). The first row's left figure is printed in an old form (rendered here as 5). The table has no printed column headings. The first column's entries are the Hebrew numbers, the other columns are the cell values as printed.
